repairs.title: Device repairs
repairs.subtitle: Phones, tablets and laptops. Screens, batteries, charging ports, water damage and more.
repairs.feeBody: A diagnosis fee applies to most repairs and is shown before you book. For many repairs it is waived when you approve the quote.

faq.q1: Will you repair my device without asking?
faq.a1: No. After inspection we send you an itemised quote. Work only starts once you approve it.
faq.q2: What if I decline the quote?
faq.a2: We stop and arrange the return of your device. Any diagnosis fee and return charge are shown before you confirm.
faq.a3: Repairs are available across serviceable Jaipur pincodes. You can check your pincode while booking.

guide.title: Prepare your device for repair
guide.intro: A few steps protect your data and help us repair your device faster.

items.backup: Back up your photos, contacts and files.
items.lock: Remove screen lock or share a temporary passcode only if the technician needs it to test the device.
items.accounts: Sign out of Find My iPhone / Find My Device if asked, so the device can be tested.
items.sim: Remove your SIM card, memory card and case.
items.charge: Charge the device if it still powers on.
items.notes: Note down any other problems you have noticed.

help.title: Help & contact
help.intro: Questions about a booking? Include your booking reference so we can help quickly.
help.trackBody: Sign in and open My bookings to see the latest status and any quote awaiting your decision.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: We collect only what we need to provide repairs: your name, phone number, email (optional), service address, and device photos you choose to upload. Photos and records are stored privately and are visible only to you and authorised staff. We use your contact details to send booking and repair updates. You can ask us to export or delete your data. Detailed retention periods will be published after legal review.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.body: Bookings are requests until confirmed by our team. Repairs begin only after you approve an itemised quote. Quotes are valid until the expiry date shown. Prices include applicable taxes as shown on the quote.

repair.title: Repair, return & warranty policy
repair.body: A diagnosis fee may apply and is disclosed before booking. If you decline a quote, we return your device unrepaired; any diagnosis fee and return charge are shown before you confirm. Repaired devices carry a warranty on replaced parts and workmanship as stated on your repair record. Physical and liquid damage after return are not covered.

developers.title: Technentium API
developers.intro: One REST API powers the website and the Android and iOS apps: devices, repair bookings and tracking, protection products, customization and content.
developers.authStep1: Sign in with email and password, or with a mobile number and a 6-digit SMS code.
developers.authStep2: Read the set-auth-token response header and store it in the device's secure storage.
developers.authStep3: Send it on every request as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Sessions last 7 days and refresh while in use.
developers.authStep4: Call POST /api/auth/sign-out to revoke the token. A 401 response means the token expired: sign in again.

envelope.title: Response envelope
envelope.body: Successful responses are { "data": … }. Errors are { "error": { code, messageKey, message, fields } } with a matching HTTP status.

money.title: Money
money.body: Amounts are integers in paise (₹1 = 100) and include GST where stated. Never compute totals on the client.

language.title: Language
language.body: Send Accept-Language: en or hi. Messages, labels and content come back in that language, falling back to English.

idempotency.title: Safe retries
idempotency.body: Submitting a booking or request needs an Idempotency-Key header. Retrying with the same key returns the original record.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.body: Lists that can grow return { items, nextCursor }. Pass nextCursor as ?cursor= to fetch the next page.

uploads.title: Images
uploads.body: Upload JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB as multipart/form-data. Images are re-encoded and location data is removed.
